fields.title: Joint weather distributions
fields.finding: MIL marginals do not supply complete coincident T/p/RH. Low-pressure data used are at 1 km, not sea level. Surface and joint hot-humid profiles need declared pressure/lapse assumptions; percentages are not global annual flyability.
fields.missing_evidence: A chosen site/mission joint sounding distribution and design-event definition.

claim: MIL marginals do not supply complete coincident T/p/RH. Low-pressure data used are at 1 km, not sea level. Surface and joint hot-humid profiles need declared pressure/lapse assumptions; percentages are not global annual flyability. | Joint weather distributions
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: Available weather points are not operational availability. The later 058 day fractions omit exclusions and do not prove a feasible continuous history with admitted air, ballast and ground recovery.
